parties: Premium Exchange and Finance Ltd; Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited
headline: Premium Exchange and Finance Ltd files SEBI Reg 31(4) disclosure on substantial acquisition in Chambal Fertilizers
sum: Premium Exchange and Finance Ltd has filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Regulations, signaling a substantial acquisition or intended open offer in Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited. The filing date (19 June 2026) marks the formal announcement trigger under India's takeover code.
detail: Premium Exchange and Finance Ltd submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, as required when an acquirer breaches the 25% shareholding threshold or announces an intention to acquire control. Chambal Fertilizers & Chemicals, a major player in the fertilizer and chemical sector listed on NSE (CHAMBLFERT), is the target. The specific shareholding percentage, offer price, and timeline for the open offer (if any) are contained in the full disclosure filing, which must be accessed via the NSE archive or company regulatory filings.
